name: jira
purpose: Retrieve one explicitly requested issue for the local Jira-to-EARS specification workflow.
capabilities: read one issue by exact key
setup_steps: Select and review the Jira MCP implementation used by the organization
Restrict the agent to issue reads and verify the exposed tool list
health_check: MCP initialize and tools/list; issue retrieval requires separate service authorization
corrective_action: Configure an approved Jira MCP locally or keep the Jira import workflow unavailable.
permissions: Read one explicitly requested issue. Creating or changing Jira issues is outside this integration.
